title: Machine learning the arithmetic of Boyd's Mahler measure conjectures
summary: Boyd conjectured that the Mahler measure of $P_k(x,y)=x+y+\frac{1}{x}+\frac{1}{y}+k$ for $k$ an integer, is given by $r_kL'(E_k,0)$, where $E_k$ is the elliptic curve associated to the zero locus of $P_k$ and $r_k$ is a rational number. We study various arithmetic properties of $r_k$ using a dataset containing the first $250{,}000$ values of $k$, combining large-scale statistical analysis assisted by Claude with transformer-based experiments carried out using Axolver.
